Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedures 
P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Fire Fighting sys. With using water are used in 
main transformers, aux. trans, turbine home and oil tank for comb. Cycle units.
When 
fire 
occur and the temp. equal (194C) the fire sensor change position from open contact to close contact there for 
due to connect voltage ( 24 VDC ) from main control panel ( system 3 ) to 
solenoid valve on fire sys. So that the water open on source of fire .
Heat Detector
Zone Number | Volt 
 DC | Alarm Current | Max. current
8 | 24 V | 10 A | 1.5 A
The first 
draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour, tested by eng. Doaa Shbana, Safty 
eng. Ashraf Gaber at 16 Feb. 2005, reviewed by EDEPC quality control eng. Abd 
El-Menem El-Emam, Safty eng. Medhat Khater accepted by general director eng. 
Yousry Abd El-Maksuod, and approved by eng. Awad Fathy head sector of Talkha 
PS.
This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
must be issued
Personal 
protective equipment must be used safety shoes, safety helmet, ...etc.
Tools and Equipment
Suitable tool set
Safety 
 helmit and safety shoes, ... etc.
Digital voltmeter model FLUKE 
 187
Contact cleaner, Heat source
Work to be Carried Out
Remove sensor.
Test the sensor in the laboratory as follows:
 a) Clean sensors.
 b) Check the continuity by using DVM (ohm) 
 should be open.
 c) Check the sensor by heat source and observe 
 the contact is closed if not change the sensor.
Measure power on connection terminals to 
 sensor to check if the voltage is within the limitation of 24 Vdc
Assemble sensor in the same location.
Test sensor in the same location.
Be sure the solenoid valve energized.
Observe deluge system working automatic.
Observe alarms on main fire alarm 
 panel (system 3 & simplex ), the water is come and check the all nozzle is 
 ok.
Make reset to fire alarm panel after alarm 
 appearance.
Test fire alarm system manually.
Observe deluge system working automatic as 
 before.
Observe alarms on main fire alarm panel 
 (system 3 & simplex ).
Make reset to fire alarm panel (system 3 & 
 simplex ) after alarms appearance.
